items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: Who was the sax player who would have diagrams and — Anthony Braxton.

ctx.x: Sometimes before the piece, sometimes there’s a list of them and I just stick one on. Because they mostly, it’s pretty hard to describe. It could be Composition #1, Composition #3, Composition #47 so the answer is they come kind of arbitrarily. I’ve got to give it a name.
Right. It needs a name. Who was the sax player who would have diagrams and — Anthony Braxton. Sometimes he would have like little drawings and stuff, that was the title.
Uh huh. Well I can understand that.
